skill.description: Generate and transform MIDI-based instrumental music, render MP3 or WAV audio, and validate output quality with music21, FluidSynth, and synthesis scripts.

content.user_title: Create MIDI-Based Music and MP3 Audio
content.value_statement: Creating original instrumental music with code is complex and requires MIDI, synthesis, and rendering knowledge. This skill provides workflows and scripts for composing, transforming, rendering, and validating audio files.
actual_capabilities: Guides algorithmic composition with music21 and MIDI output.
Renders classical and acoustic arrangements through FluidSynth and SoundFonts.
Renders electronic tracks with built-in drum, bass, pad, and lead synthesis scripts.
Extracts MIDI structure to JSON for analysis and reuse.
Transforms MIDI-derived JSON by transposition, tempo scaling, looping, instrument swaps, and reversal.
Validates rendered audio for clipping, silence, duration, loudness, and dynamic range.
limitations: Instrumental output only; it does not synthesize vocals or lyrics.
Audio quality depends on available SoundFonts and synthesis presets.
Rendering requires local Python packages plus FluidSynth or FFmpeg for some workflows.
The scripts process local files and do not provide real-time playback.

use_cases.title: Score Video Background Music
use_cases.description: Create timed instrumental tracks for videos, presentations, and product demos.

use_cases.title: Prototype Game Music Loops
use_cases.description: Generate MIDI-based loops, electronic beds, and short themes for iteration.

use_cases.title: Study And Rework MIDI Files
use_cases.description: Extract structure from MIDI files, change instruments, and render new versions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30 second piano theme in C major. Make it calm, simple, and render it as an MP3.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Video Cue
prompt_templates.prompt: Compose a 60 second string quartet cue for a product video. Include a soft intro, a brighter middle, and a resolved ending.

prompt_templates.title: Transform Existing MIDI
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this MIDI file, change the lead instrument to violin, transpose it up two semitones, and render a new MP3.

prompt_templates.title: Render Electronic Production
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 90 second deep house track with drums, bass, pads, and lead. Use the electronic renderer, validate clipping, and summarize mix adjustments.

output_examples.input: Create a 45 second calm piano piece for a meditation video.
output_examples.output: A rendered MP3 and MIDI file with a soft piano theme, steady tempo, and gentle ending.

output_examples.input: Turn this MIDI file into a violin arrangement.
output_examples.output: An analyzed arrangement with the lead part moved to violin, rendered as a new audio file.

output_examples.input: Make a short deep house loop with warm bass and pads.
output_examples.output: A rendered electronic MP3 with synthesized kick, bass, pads, lead, and a clipping validation summary.

best_practices: Define style, length, tempo, and target instruments before generating.
Render a short draft first, then adjust structure, velocity, and mix balance.
Validate final audio for clipping, silence, and duration before delivery.
anti_patterns: Requesting copyrighted melodies or direct recreations without rights.
Using electronic presets for orchestral music or SoundFonts for club tracks without checking fit.
Skipping velocity and range checks for dense multi-instrument arrangements.

faq.question: Can this skill create vocals?
faq.answer: No. It creates instrumental MIDI-based music and rendered audio files.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it need internet access?
faq.answer: Rendering is local after setup. Installation may need network access for packages.

faq.question: What formats does it support?
faq.answer: It works with MIDI, JSON structure files, WAV, and MP3 outputs.

faq.question: Can it use existing MIDI files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can extract structure, transform parts, and render new versions.

faq.question: How realistic is the sound?
faq.answer: Quality depends on SoundFonts for acoustic music and presets for electronic synthesis.
